client.name: Phoenix Roofing Outreach
client.description: Phoenix metro roofing companies - storm season approaching, high-ticket jobs

icp.q_keywords: roofing OR roofer OR roof repair OR roof replacement OR shingles OR storm damage

qualification.ideal_customer_description: A Phoenix-area roofing company with a dated, generic, or broken website that undersells a high-ticket trade ($5K-25K+ jobs). The kind of site that loses bids to better-looking competitors before the homeowner ever calls.
qualification.service_focus: A complete, modern website redesign — already built for them — delivered with a 30-second video walkthrough. Not a services pitch; a finished site they can see before they reply.

email.tone: a real person who already did the work, not a salesperson
custom_guidelines: Do NOT use phrases like 'I hope this email finds you well'
The angle is: I already built you a new site — here's a 30-sec video of it
Reference that their current site doesn't match the quality of their actual roofing work
The poster image links to the hosted walkthrough video; CTA is reply for the live link
No feature list, no services pitch — the built site IS the pitch
